title: Pre-Registered EFC Prediction: EG Statistic from SO × Euclid Cross-Correlation
description: This sealed pre-registration specifies the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the EG gravitational-slip statistic to be tested with the Simons Observatory LAT × Euclid DR2 cross-correlation. It forecasts an 8.6% enhancement of EG relative to the GR/ΛCDM pipeline baseline from jointly predicted µ < 1 (growth suppression) and Σ > 1 (lensing enhancement), and fixes pass/fail windows and a binding falsification (kill) criterion prior to data availability.

eg_statistic.description: Definition of the EG statistic combining CMB lensing–galaxy cross-correlation and galaxy auto-correlation with the RSD parameter \beta = f/b.

mg_to_gr_ratio.description: Operational relation for modified gravity under quasi-static, sub-horizon conditions linking EG to ratios of lensing and dynamical modifications relative to the GR pipeline baseline.

efc_action.latex: S_{\rm EFC} = \int d^4x\, \sqrt{-g} \left[ \tfrac{1}{2} M_{\rm Pl}^2 F(\phi) R - \tfrac{1}{2} K(\rho) \, g^{\mu\nu} \partial_\mu \phi \, \partial_\nu \phi - V(\phi) - \lambda \, \Box \phi - \Gamma(\rho) \right]
efc_action.description: Relativistic variational action for EFC yielding coupled background and perturbation dynamics, from which (\mu, \Sigma, \eta) are obtained self-consistently.

efc_prediction.description: Sealed numerical prediction for the EG enhancement at the stated pivot scale and redshift, defined in the survey pipeline frame including tomographic convolution.

efc_mu_sigma_eta.description: EFC perturbation-sector predictions: growth suppression (\mu<1), lensing enhancement (\Sigma>1), and non-unity gravitational slip (\eta\neq 1).

key_results.main_finding: Sealed pre-registration of an EFC prediction that EG will be enhanced by 8.6% ± 1.2% over the GR pipeline baseline in SO × Euclid DR2, with fixed pass/fail windows and a binding kill criterion.
datasets_used: Simons Observatory LAT CMB lensing (kappa reconstruction)
Euclid DR2 photometric galaxy catalog (z ∈ [0.3, 0.8], 5 tomographic bins)

sealed_predictions.statement: Survey-pipeline EG enhancement: (E_G^EFC / E_G^GR) = 1.086 ± 0.012 at kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc^{-1}, z_eff ≈ 0.5, ℓ ∈ [50, 500], including tomographic window functions.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: SO LAT × Euclid DR2 CMB-lensing × galaxy cross-correlation EG measurement in the stated configuration.

sealed_predictions.statement: Pass window: E_G^obs / E_G^GR ∈ [1.03, 1.14] at > 1σ (tomography-convolved, survey pipeline definition).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Primary SO × Euclid DR2 EG analysis using survey-provided covariance, NLA + linear bias marginalization, and scale cuts k < 0.2 h Mpc^{-1}.

sealed_predictions.statement: Fail (kill) condition: E_G^obs / E_G^GR = 1.00 ± 0.01 at > 3σ implies |η − 1| < 0.01 and falsifies the EFC gravitational-slip sector (FA4).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A high-significance SO × Euclid DR2 EG result consistent with GR/ΛCDM within ±1% across the adopted pivot and ℓ-range.

kill_criteria: KC1 (FA4): If the SO × Euclid EG measurement yields E_G^obs / E_G^GR = 1.00 ± 0.01 at > 3σ (pipeline definition; kc ≈ 0.05 h Mpc^{-1}, z_eff ≈ 0.5; ℓ ∈ [50, 500]), the EFC gravitational-slip sector is formally falsified and abandoned.

KC2 (FA4 equivalence): If |η − 1| < 0.01 is established at > 3σ from the SO × Euclid EG analysis in the quasi-static, sub-horizon regime, the EFC perturbation sector is falsified and the result is permanently recorded in the Validation Ledger.

related_packages.role: Frozen EFC parameters (µ0, Σ0, η) and governance registry referenced by this pre-registration.

Mapping of EFC to EFT-of-DE (Bellini–Sawicki) confirming α_T = 0 and compatibility with Euclid EFT pipelines.
